description: DUYA retrievable memory (RAG) UserPromptSubmit hook — runs scripts/memory-rag-hook.mjs in the BACKGROUND on every user prompt (async: true, never blocks the agent loop). When retrieval finishes, asyncRewake delivers the related memories back into the session as a background notification the next turn — the model sees them without the agent having waited. EDIT the args[0] path below to match the duya install location on this machine (dev repo path or packaged resources path — see the memory-search skill for how to resolve it).
